name: Pedal Path
description: Live on the App Store. One of an ongoing run of small, useful apps with no subscriptions. Free to use, with a one-time unlock for the premium features.

name: Story Builder
description: In development. A tool I built for my own editing workflow. Search interview transcripts, audition exact quotes, and arrange them into a paper edit, with source timecodes carried through to Final Cut Pro. Connect your preferred AI assistant through MCP and let it operate Story Builder for you.

Centered Script view with fictional narration and source timecodes
Board view with fictional story beat cards

name: Unbusy Scanner
description: Live at unbusyscanner.vercel.app. Scans any URL for agent-readability, MCP endpoints, friction score, opportunity gap. (Next.js, Claude API, Vercel)

name: Production Intelligence
description: Internal. A database-backed AI note system for production work. Client context, project history, and research get stored with semantic search and auto-tagging, and my AI tools read it all through a custom MCP server.

name: Gibbon Knight
description: Live at gibbon-knight.vercel.app. Gamified dyslexia reading app with karaoke highlighting, phonetic hints, boss-fight mechanic, and mic-ducking music. (React, Web Speech API, TipTap, Vercel)

name: Ultimate PPL
description: Personal use. A training log I built for my own six-day push/pull/legs plan. It runs the full thirteen weeks, shows last week's numbers beside every lift, and lets me swap or skip an exercise on the day. Syncs across my devices.
